title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
description: Motivation: reduce per-token inference cost for typical production workloads by providing safe defaults and automated tuning that balance latency SLOs with unit economics. This PR introduces: 1) a new autotune pipeline that suggests batching and prefix-KV caching defaults per route based on recent traffic profiles; 2) quantization profile metadata and recommended presets for common family-models (e.g., redwood-7b, redwood-13b, and select Llama-family variants); 3) a unit-economics dashboard backend that surfaces expected cost savings, estimated latency impact, and confidence intervals for each recommended change. Scope: runtime + control-plane + console telemetry + small SDK surface. Checklist: - [x] Collect per-route telemetry and histogram summaries (p95 latency, seq-length distribution, token-rate) - [x] Implement autotune suggestion engine (simulator + conservative constraints to preserve latency SLOs) - [x] Add quantization profile schema and presets - [x] Expose suggestions via /v1/autotune endpoint and console UI - [x] Add unit-econ computation and a new per-route report in Console - [x] End-to-end tests for suggestion safety and rollback - [x] Docs and changelog entry Breaking changes: none (changes are opt-in and default suggestions are off for existing routes). Related: Linear ENG-2874, ENG-2918; incident SUP-1127 (follow-up from cost spike), design doc: internal/eng/cost-autotune.md. Implementation notes: - Autotune runs a lightweight simulator that replays sampled recent requests and evaluates batching/caching/quantization combos against latency SLOs (p95) and token-cost model. - Suggestions include numeric confidence and a rollback plan (e.g., canary % and automatic revert if observed p95 regresses > 10%). - Quant profiles are metadata only; actual quantized model variants are gated behind model registry entries and require operator-approved rollout. - Unit-econ tooling computes expected savings and expected change in latency distribution, surfaced to the Console with an actionable CTA to apply suggested changes. Data migration: add autotune_suggestions table (backfill from 30d of traffic samples). Rollout plan: feature-flagged, staged rollout to 10% of orgs, monitored for regressions.
author: Ava Chen

Ava Chen: Implemented conservative caps and automatic canary plan (default 5% rollout with automatic revert on >10% p95 regression).
Evan Brooks: CI flaked on first run (timeout on telemetry aggregation). Re-ran and passed; please add retry to telemetry collector.
Ava Chen: Added retries and timeout tuning; CI green on subsequent runs.

release_notes: Introduces an experimental Autotune feature: per-route recommendations for batching, prefix-KV caching defaults, and quantization profile suggestions. Adds a Unit Economics report in Console showing estimated cost savings and confidence. Feature is behind a feature flag and rolled out gradually.
